subject: Security validation follow-up: post-remediation confirmation and evidence request
messages:
From: Amy Hart <amy.hart@zencloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: verification after remediation for September pen test

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for coordinating with us on the September 20th penetration test. Our internal engineering team completed the remediation work on Oct 1 (per the vendor recommendations) and we want to request a formal validation from Redwood so we can close the loop for our compliance team.

Specifically we are looking for either: 1) a short validation scan + delta report from Redwood that confirms the high/critical findings have been remediated, or 2) an attestation/verification letter that you can provide if Redwood accepts the vendor evidence without an on-site re-scan.

Can you confirm what you need from our side (remediation logs, patches, test evidence), and whether Redwood can run a limited validation window next week? Our compliance deadline is Oct 20 so the sooner the better.

I can share the remediation tracker and vendor patch notes if that helps — happy to upload to Drive or send directly.

Thanks,
Amy Hart
Head of Security, ZenCloud
amy.hart@zencloud.com
Office: +1 415-555-0199

--
ZenCloud Security Team
security@zencloud.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Amy Hart <amy.hart@zencloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: verification after remediation for September pen test

Amy — thanks for the note and congrats to your team on getting fixes shipped.

Short answer: we can do either option, but our standard practice for vendor remediation is to review the remediation artifacts first and then run a short, targeted validation scan for the remediated findings. After validation, we provide a delta report and a verification letter you can share with auditors.

What we need from you to start:
- remediation tracker (spreadsheet) with entry for each finding (id, description, fix deployed date, owner)
- vendor patch notes and any PoC/validation screenshots or logs
- scope confirmation (are we validating production endpoints, staging only, or both?)

Proposed validation approach:
1) Redwood security engineer reviews artifacts (1–2 business days)
2) We schedule a 2-hour validation window (non-intrusive scans + quick manual verification)
3) If all remediations check out, we issue a delta report + verification letter within 48 hours; if we find residual issues, we produce a short remediation plan and a follow-up retest schedule.

Are you able to share artifacts here or via the Drive link you mentioned? We have availability for validation windows Oct 12–15 (UTC times listed below). Please confirm preferred time zone and whether production access will be needed.

I’ll loop Neha from our security team to lead the artifact review.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0142
From: Amy Hart <amy.hart@zencloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: verification after remediation for September pen test

Vivek — attaching the artifacts now.

Attachments:
- zencloud_remediation_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet with IDs, remediation notes, evidence links)
- vendor_patch_notes.pdf (notes from the third‑party vendor that performed original testing and the supplied fixes)

We confirmed scope: validation should run against production public endpoints only (no internal admin panels). We can provide temporary read-only test accounts if needed — will send credentials via the secure portal once Redwood confirms the validation window.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aZxQk-zencloud-evidence

Let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks,
Amy
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amy Hart <amy.hart@zencloud.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 07:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: verification after remediation for September pen test

Thanks for the artifacts — I reviewed the remediation tracker and patch notes this morning. High-level assessment:

- The vendor addressed the three high/critical findings reported on 2026-09-20 and provided PoC screenshots for two of them.
- One medium/low issue (CVE-2026-2345 — information disclosure) appears to have been mitigated by configuration change; evidence is acceptable but we like to perform a short validation to confirm the production behavior.
- No new critical regressions are evident from the artifacts.

Recommended validation:
- Scope: production public endpoints only (as requested).
- Tests: non-intrusive authenticated scan + manual verification for the three previously high/critical items and a quick check for CVE-2026-2345.
- Window: 2 hours (we’ll coordinate IP allowlisting).
- Acceptance: if no residual high/critical findings are present we will produce a delta report and a verification letter. If the medium issue persists we will document it as a residual low finding and include remediation guidance.

I’ve attached a short validation_plan.docx that outlines the exact checks and the validation timeline. Proposed window: Tue Oct 12 16:00–18:00 UTC (we can shift earlier/later as needed).

Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachment: validation_plan.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Amy Hart <amy.hart@zencloud.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: verification after remediation for September pen test

Amy — thanks for the quick turnaround and to Neha for the assessment. The proposed plan and window work for us.

Confirming next steps:
1) ZenCloud will provide temporary read-only credentials and IP allowlist by Oct 11 EOD (please upload to the Drive or send via the secure portal).
2) Redwood will run the validation on Tue Oct 12 16:00–18:00 UTC. Non-intrusive scans + manual checks only.
3) Redwood will produce a delta report and a verification letter within 48 hours after the validation window if the three high/critical items are confirmed remediated. If any residual issues are found we will call them out and propose a follow-up retest schedule.

We also offer to provide a short DocuSign verification letter for your auditors (standard wording confirming validation scope and findings) — if ZenCloud prefers that, please confirm and we’ll send the DocuSign to the security contact.

Attached: redwood_validation-sla.pdf (summary of what Redwood’s validation covers and turnaround SLA).

Appreciate the collaboration — we’ll stand by for credentials and the allowlist.

Best,
Vivek
